text:
maria: Finance flagged a ~ $42k spike in GPU spend in us-central1 for the last billing week. They say cost-center tag is missing on ~1k VM hours. Anyone see a recent change to autoscaler templates?

cheng: Noted. Do we have the BQ export query? I can run a join on billing_export.gcp_billing_export_v1 to find untagged resources.

cheng: Query I ran:
```
SELECT project, resource_name, service, sku_description, cost, labels
FROM `billing.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`
WHERE invoice_month = '2026-02'
  AND (labels IS NULL OR labels = {})
  AND sku_description LIKE '%NVIDIA%'
LIMIT 100
```

sarah: That's the one. The spike mostly maps to `redwood-dev-training` project but product team says those are infra-shared jobs. Need to allocate to product or research.

alex: On it. Hypothesis: historical jobs launched via k8s cluster autoscaler used an instance template missing `cost_center` label because we switched to instance_template_v2 in Jan. The new template doesn't pull pod annotations.

maria: That matches a change I rolled Jan 11. I swapped to instance_template_v2 to support preemptible pools — I might've missed metadata passthrough.

cheng: Ok we can do two things: 1) fix template going forward, 2) retroactively reconstruct attribution by correlating GCE instance IDs with node autoscaler events + kubelet node annotations stored in logging. I can run a join between billing export, compute.instances.get, and GKE audit logs.

cheng: Example join (rough):
```
# pseudo-BQ
SELECT b.resource_name, b.cost, a.instance_id, k.pod_annotations
FROM `billing.*` b
LEFT JOIN `gcp.compute_instances` a ON b.resource_name = a.resource_name
LEFT JOIN `gke.audit_logs` k ON a.instance_name = k.resource_name
WHERE b.labels = {} AND b.sku LIKE '%GPU%'
```

sarah: If we can map >95% of spend, finance will accept a chargeback memo. Otherwise they want to split proportionally across teams using the cluster.

alex: I can update instance_template_v2 to include `labels: { cost_center: '{{JOB_OWNER}}', owner: '{{TEAM}}' }` but need to coordinate with SRE because rolling this will cause node refresh.

maria: Let's avoid a mass node refresh. Can we make the autoscaler append labels at launch via a startup-script that reads pod annotations and then sets labels through the GCE API? Safer and easier to roll back.

cheng: Good call. For the retrospective attribution I estimate a 6-8 hour BQ job and a follow-up reconciliation script to assign internal credits. I'll own the query. @sarah can you prepare the chargeback memo? Also need a list of product owners.

sarah: I'll draft memo. Timeline: get query results by EOD Tue, memo Wed, finance sign-off by next Fri. If we need to do credits, prefer to apply to March invoice.

ops-bot: Incident created: #INC-2314 'untagged-gpu-billing-investigation' assigned to '@cheng', priority 'P3'.

alex: I'll schedule a small canary template change to include labels + startup script Tuesday night; won't roll to prod until we validate. Tagging update PR: https://github.com/redwood-infra/infra/compare/label-autoscaler

maria: Action items summarized: cheng -> run BQ joins + produce CSV; alex -> implement startup script + PR; sarah -> chargeback memo; maria -> revert template change if needed and coordinate PR. Ping me if you need quota.

cheng: I'll post the query results CSV to the thread when done. Thanks all :thumbsup:
